data.name: Scape
data.detailed_description:
The higher you get, the more you lose. 

Gravity does not forgive. One wrong step and you free-fall. Catch a ledge and save yourself, or keep falling. Wherever you land is where you start the climb again. This is Gravity, the first game in Scape, a growing platform of games that starts here and goes much further. 

One in a hundred. 

You are not alone here. Up to 100 players climb the same world at the same time. Race for the top, or hang back and learn from the ones who fall past you. You decide how you want to climb. 

Nobody has been through the door. 

Most platformers stop at the summit. In Gravity, the summit is a closed door. Reaching it means one thing: you were here first. 

Gravity is the first game in Scape. 

Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games we are building openly. Gravity is the first one you can play. What you unlock in Gravity is attached to your character rather than to the game, so it stays with you as Scape grows. 

Talk to us.

Steam discussions and our Discord are open and active every day. Tell us what is working, and what is not. We read and discuss, and then we act on it. The community has already shaped this game, and it will keep doing so.

data.short_description: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Core i5-10600K / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060, AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT, Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
